why: Camp America is the former name of Dakota Sunsets Campground (15751, added from lead 3). Both are at 25495 US Highway 81, Salem SD 57058. RoverPass's unclaimed 'Camp America Campground' listing (read 2026-11-22) gives that address and the old phone (605) 425-9085, with its point 43.68889,-97.38995, 29 m from 15751's pin. The Dyrt's page at the slug /camping/south-dakota/camp-america-campground (read 2026-11-22) now titles it 'Dakota Sunsets RV Park' at 25495 US Highway 81, with its point 109 m from the pin. Good Sam's directory URL slug camp-america-campground-300004625 also carries the Dakota Sunsets listing (seen in search results; goodsam.com refuses automated reads). The DB holds no other entry within 2 km and no other entry named Camp America.
name: Camp America Campground
flags: Old phone (605) 425-9085 belongs to Camp America; the current operator phone is 605-705-3234, as already stored on 15751. Aggregators (RoverPass, AAA, camping-usa, rvparking) still list the old name, so later leads may surface it again.
